items.summary: Site-factory disposition: maintain a three-item bounded pipeline—complicated.work, deadlymaracas.com, and driveford.net—as scaffold candidates requiring verified launch-readiness artifacts before any build or public exposure. Each artifact must include owner and audience, bounded scope, reusable template, initial content seed, SEO metadata/sitemap baseline, analytics and affiliate readiness without invented telemetry, legal/compliance checklist, security checklist, measurement plan, rollback point, and preview-only launch gate. Current analytics are unconfigured for these candidates; monetization readiness and launch quality remain unknown. No domains, spend, deployment, or launch are authorized. Exactly one next step: after CTO releases one delivery slot, complete the existing site-factory readiness artifact for complicated.work and route unresolved owner, legal, security, measurement, or rollback blockers for review.
